text: The simply typed lambda calculus (with only arrow types) corresponds, under Curry–Howard, to which logic?
choices: the implicational fragment of minimal/intuitionistic propositional logic
explanation: STLC corresponds exactly to the implication fragment of minimal/intuitionistic propositional logic: λ-abstraction is →-introduction, application is →-elimination, and strong normalization is cut elimination. System F, not STLC, corresponds to second-order logic (B); classical logic (A) needs extra principles like LEM; S5 (D) is unrelated.
